title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 unauthenticated connection to an arbitrary host via run…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4 allows unauthenticated connections to arbitrary hosts via run configurations. This flaw could lead to high confidentiality and integrity impact but does not affect availability.
